title: Honest Prayer - Homeward Practice

blocks.label: Text: Bringing your whole truth into God's presence.
blocks.value: Bringing your whole truth into God's presence.

blocks.label: Text: Set aside ten quiet minutes. You may want a journal nearby. Honest Praye…
blocks.value: Set aside ten quiet minutes. You may want a journal nearby. Honest Prayer is not a technique for making doubt disappear. It is a way of refusing to pretend and bringing the real question into relationship with God.

blocks.label: Text: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow b…
blocks.value: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow breath.

blocks.label: Text: Say or write the question, feeling, anger, fear, or disappointment witho…
blocks.value: Say or write the question, feeling, anger, fear, or disappointment without editing yourself for God.

blocks.label: Text: What do you need? What do you wish God would do? Let your prayer be spec…
blocks.value: What do you need? What do you wish God would do? Let your prayer be specific, even if it feels unfinished or impossible.

blocks.label: Text: Is there one thread of trust, desire, love, or hope still present? Do no…
blocks.value: Is there one thread of trust, desire, love, or hope still present? Do not manufacture one. Simply notice what remains.

blocks.label: Text: Sit in silence for one minute. You do not need to solve the question bef…
blocks.value: Sit in silence for one minute. You do not need to solve the question before you leave.

blocks.label: Heading: Try this for seven days.
Text: Write one honest sentence each day. The aim is not certainty. It is a mo…
blocks.value: Write one honest sentence each day. The aim is not certainty. It is a more truthful relationship with God.

meta_description: A guided practice for bringing questions, doubt, grief, and longing honestly into the presence of God.
